scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test:integration: RUN_TENANT_DB_TESTS=true RUN_ACCESS_CONTROL_DB_TESTS=true RUN_CONTINUOUS_TELEMETRY_DB_TESTS=true RUN_CONNECTOR_INGESTION_DB_TESTS=true node --env-file-if-exists=.env artifacts/api-server/node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs --root artifacts/api-server run src/lib/tenant-security.integration.test.ts src/lib/access-control.integration.test.ts src/lib/continuous-telemetry.integration.test.ts src/lib/connector-ingestion.integration.test.ts src/lib/executive-reporting.integration.test.ts src/lib/professional-plan-service.integration.test.ts src/lib/admission-catalog.integration.test.ts
scripts.validate:gauntlet: pnpm run build && pnpm test && pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run test:e2e
